reviews.author: Muhammad Salman
reviews.content:
Need me a Makima 🙏.

I'm convinced MAPPA got some blackmail stuff on their employees because HOW THE FUCK did they animate these scenes cuh.

And I speak for **EVERYONE** when I say that **WE** will let Reze manipulate us and take advantage of us.
Imagine you clapping them crazy cheeks and right wen u boutta buss she whispers in yo ear, **_“BOOM!"_**. I would die the fuck right there. 😭😭😭

Seriously tho, I did NOT expect this movie to have one of the best action sequences of the year.

I need whatever the hell these MAPPA animators are smoking, because HOW TF did they animate those scenes?

I didn't even care about Chainsaw Man a few days ago. But then I saw the great reviews for this movie so I decided to binge Season 1 to prepare for the movie. And now here I am thinking that this might be my favorite action movie of the year.

MAN, this movie was beautiful. And it's not just the action scenes that were good, but the story it's adapting (from the manga) is also soooooo good.

Don't even get me started on the music. "In The Pool" made me cry ngl. Even thinking about listening to that song is making me feel depressed and anxious.




Edit: WHY THE FUCK does that song sound so depressing, just thinking about listening to that song makes my chest start feeling heavy. This has never happened to me before. FUCK.

GOD I MISS HER

reviews.author: CinemaSerf
reviews.content: Student “Denji” is already an accomplished demon hunter for the Japanese mob when they betray him and think him dead. Fortunately for him, his quick thinking and chainsaw wielding dog manages to morph together with his master thereby creating a critter with even more formidable devil slaying skills - and that is just as well because they are coming for him. Not, however, in the way he is expecting but via a much more subtle approach. That’s because the seemingly ditzy “Reze” enters his life, via a storm and a phone booth, and despite the fact that he has sworn to love “Makima”, he is soon entranced by her. Thing is, though, is she all that she seems? Now on a practical front, are chainsaws emanating from your arms and head really that useful a weapon when your opponent is as lithe and nimble as a ninja made from jelly? Well we are about to see as this action-packed animation hits the ground running and rarely pauses for breath as poor old “Denji” has to distinguish between friend and foe whilst his hormones do some independent raging of their own. It’s a stand-alone arc from the series so you don’t really miss out on much if you haven’t followed his adventures before, and there are all sorts of colourful mystical creatures for him to combat without the often used game-level look to these films. It has a defined and structured plot, with much more of a beginning and an end to it and though we don’t spend a load of time focussing on the characters (or their development!!) this is still one of the liveliest “love” stories you’ll likely ever have seen. It also benefits from being quite short, and so it can sustain the adventure elements better as the pace starts off fairly frenetically and doesn’t slow up. There’s a sort of slushy phase at the start, but don’t worry it doesn’t last as this vividly animated slasher makes idle work for the devil’s hands.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a chaotic world where devils and hunters clash, Denji's life grows even more perilous when a charming young woman named Reze enters his life, sparking a deadly struggle between burgeoning affection and brutal survival.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Denji, a hybrid devil hunter wielding the power of the Chainsaw Devil, encounters Reze, a seemingly kind girl who works at a local café. As the two grow closer, Denji begins to dream of a normal life filled with romance and genuine human connection. However, Reze harbors dangerous secrets that pull Denji into one of the most explosive and lethal battles of his life. Caught between his feelings and the harsh realities of his world, Denji must fight to survive against formidable forces.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Following his intense battles as a Public Safety Devil Hunter, Denji continues to navigate a brutal world where survival is never guaranteed. His violent routine takes an unexpected turn when he meets Reze, a warm and captivating girl who offers him kindness without demanding anything in return. Drawn to her charm, Denji quickly falls in love and begins to envision a peaceful future far removed from the bloody demands of hunting devils. As their bond deepens during late-night encounters, Denji finds himself questioning his loyalty to his work and his desire for simple happiness. However, Reze is not the ordinary civilian she appears to be, but a lethal operative with a hidden agenda tied to powerful secret organizations. When her true identity and terrifying powers are revealed, Denji's romantic dream abruptly transforms into a harrowing nightmare. Reze unleashes a chaotic storm of destruction, forcing Denji and his fellow hunters into a high-stakes confrontation. Despite the devastation around him, Denji struggles emotionally with fighting someone he genuinely cared for. Ultimately, Denji must push his Chainsaw hybrid capabilities to their absolute limits in a fiercely cinematic showdown where love, betrayal, and violence collide.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in a ruthless world overrun by terrifying devils and the specialized hunters tasked with eliminating them, this chapter follows Denji, a young hybrid hunter with chainsaw powers trying to find comfort in a bleak life. Unexpectedly, he meets Reze, a mysterious and charming girl whose presence brings a soft, romantic light into his chaotic existence. As Denji allows himself to hope for a normal life full of affection, dark secrets begin to surface around Reze's sudden appearance. A subtle tension builds into an explosive conflict, testing the fragile boundaries between trust, love, and survival.

story_structure.climax: Denji engages in a ferocious, high-octane battle with Reze, using his wits and Chainsaw powers to stand against her devastating explosive abilities.
story_structure.conflict: Reze's sweet facade hides a deadly secret—she is an enemy operative sent to capture Denji's heart, forcing Denji to choose between his yearning for real love and his struggle to survive.
story_structure.resolution: The aftermath leaves a bittersweet impact on Denji, forcing him to process the harsh reality of his feelings while preparing for the dangerous road ahead as Chainsaw Man.
story_structure.introduction: Denji, a Public Safety Devil Hunter, meets a charming cafe worker named Reze on a rainy day, quickly developing romantic feelings as she introduces him to a sweeter, more tender side of life.
story_structure.risingAction: Reze reveals her explosive true form, unleashing catastrophic destruction across the city while Denji and his fellow hunters fight back against her overwhelming barrage of attacks.
